name: A later sentence's "if" does not gate the sentence before it (Chilling Trap, For the Family below four creatures)
notes: Memory: project_audit_target_changes_nothing_2026-10-11. Found by tests/audit.py (target-changes-nothing). "Target creature gets -4/-0 until end of turn. If you control a Wizard, draw a card." changed nothing: the condition parser's trailing-if pattern also matches a sentence-leading "If X," in the middle of a line, and a condition is kept per line, so the first sentence was gated by the second one's condition. A later sentence with no continuous effect now registers no condition (cards-parser.js, Pattern D), and one with a continuous effect is moved to a line of its own by _splitConditionalBranches ("… instead" also negates the sentence it replaces). With two creatures For the Family gives +2/+2, not +4/+4.
